subject: Starlane PO — multi-jurisdiction issuance and line-item code update
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@starlane.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Starlane vendor onboarding — PO issuance & jurisdiction split

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday — happy to start the PO issuance and vendor setup. A couple of asks from our side so we can issue POs without delay: 

- Can you confirm Starlane's registered tax jurisdictions? Our finance team is requesting separate POs for US and Canada entities if you'll be invoicing both regions (this avoids cross-jurisdiction tax friction).
- Please return the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf completed (W-9 for US entities, VAT cert for Canada if applicable).
- We need final SKU-to-line-item mapping so we can populate GL codes. If you can send a CSV with exact SKUs and unit descriptions we'll attach it to the PO.

Target timeline: we aim to issue the PO(s) by EOD Monday (21 Dec) if we have the forms and SKU mapping by COB tomorrow. Marcus (cc'd) will confirm spend-cap allocation per quarter.

Thanks — we want to make this simple for both sides.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@starlane.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Starlane vendor onboarding — PO issuance & jurisdiction split

Hi Mina,

Thanks — we can do that. Quick clarifications: 
- Starlane has two billing entities: Starlane Networks, Inc. (US, EIN 12-3456789) and Starlane Canada Ltd. (BN 987654321RT0001). We typically ask customers to issue separate POs per legal entity.
- I'm attaching our signed W9 for the US entity and a VAT certificate for the Canada subsidiary.
- Attached is a first-pass SKU list but it doesn't have your GL codes — see WIP attached (W9_Starlane.pdf, VAT_Cert_Starlane.pdf). We'll provide the cleaned CSV by EOD tomorrow.

One additional note: we have a quarterly spend cap request from our finance team to ensure projected spend doesn't exceed negotiated thresholds. If Redwood needs a specific cap per quarter for the Dedicated contract, flag the amounts and we'll confirm acceptance.

I'll send the final SKU mapping tomorrow AM.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Procurement | Starlane Networks
alicia.gomez@starlane.io

Attachments: W9_Starlane.pdf (PDF), VAT_Cert_Starlane.pdf (PDF)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Starlane vendor onboarding — PO issuance & jurisdiction split

Mina / Laura,

Thanks for the heads up. Finance guidelines here: 
- We require a spend cap field on each PO tied to a quarterly allowance for new customers on Dedicated. For this pilot we can provision a $120k quarterly cap for Q1 and monthly drawdown reporting.
- Please split the PO into two references if vendor will invoice both legal entities (US + CA). Use separate purchase refs so tax codes map cleanly in our ledger.
- Line items must include the following columns: SKU | Description | Qty | Unit Price | Total | GL Code. If the vendor cannot provide GL codes, I'll assign provisional GLs but we prefer vendor-supplied codes to avoid rework.

I'll review the final CSV when Alicia sends it. 

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.example.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@starlane.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: PO numbers and proposed line items (please confirm)

Alicia —

Thanks for the documents. Based on the SKU CSV you provided this morning I have drafted the two POs we discussed. We will issue the following provisional purchase references once you confirm the SKU to GL mapping and accept the line-item split: 

- PO-79211-US — Starlane Networks, Inc. (US) — allotted quarterly cap $120,000 — currency USD
- PO-79212-CA — Starlane Canada Ltd. (CA) — allotted quarterly cap CAD 160,000 equivalent — currency CAD

Attached: PO_lineitems_v2.csv (CSV) which includes the proposed line items mapped to Redwood's provisional GLs. Key callouts: 
- We separated hardware (Edge Accelerator) from services (Deployment & Support) as discrete line items so invoices can be processed under different GLs.
- We included a tax line for CA invoices so your team can see how the tax amount is captured separately.

Please confirm by reply to this thread with (a) acceptance of the two PO refs, (b) any corrections to SKUs, and (c) whether you need the PO issued as a single combined document or two legal-entity-specific documents. Once you reply we will generate the PO PDFs and send for signature.

Thanks,
Mina
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_lineitems_v2.csv (CSV, 1 sheet)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@starlane.io>

Cc: procure@starlane.io
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO numbers and proposed line items (please confirm)

On Mon, Dec 21, 2026 at 08:07 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.example.com> wrote:
> Alicia —
> 
> Thanks for the documents. Based on the SKU CSV you provided this morning I have drafted the two POs we discussed. We will issue the following provisional purchase references once you confirm the SKU to GL mapping and accept the line-item split: 

Thanks, Mina — confirmed. A couple of micro-changes from our side before signature: 
1) SKU correction: the Edge Accelerator hardware SKU shows as SKU-EA-21 in your CSV — that should be SKU-EA-21A (firmware v2.1A). Please update the CSV or confirm you will change it on the PO; invoices must match the SKU on our customs paperwork.
2) CA tax handling: for PO-79212-CA can you move the tax line to appear after the subtotal and include the tax registration number in the PO footer (we need the PO to show 'Tax Reg: BN 987654321RT0001').

We're fine with two separate legal-entity POs (preferred). We accept the quarterly caps as proposed. Please issue the two PO PDFs and route them back; we will sign electronically (DocuSign link works for us).

HubSpot: I updated the company record with the final billing contacts (see https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890).

I'll send a corrected CSV with the SKU change in the next hour.

Thanks — Alicia
Head of Procurement | Starlane Networks
